title: SQL Firewall Violations
description: SQL Firewall events or blocked activity.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and ('Event Name' like '*FIREWALL*' or 'Action Taken' like '*BLOCK*') | stats count as 'Violations' by 'Data Safe Target Name', 'Database User', 'Action Taken' | sort -'Violations'
